searchText: why does https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/kiln#Geth still point to `merge-kiln-v2`? The plan is to have a mainnet shadow fork on the 23rd of April. Configs aren't out yet, but you can start by syncing a mainnet node already and add the new config later on. Got it. Thank you.
